verdict.rationale: The runtime probe found that kimi.com publishes no llms.txt: the URL redirects to the SPA root, and the assistant app has no docs site. The only real llms.txt sits at platform.kimi.ai and belongs to the Kimi API Open Platform, which the vendor's own product-plans doc treats as a separate product, so it is not credited here. The Kimi Code docs exist, but nothing in the evidence says they are offered as agent-oriented or machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
